params.body:
Refs #390

- Collapsed object results that carry a string `outcome` now append it: `Returned 12 fields: outcome, status, conclusion · outcome: "pending"`.
- `pr.waitForChecks` says `1 check is still pending`; `ci.waitForRun` says `after 1 check` / `1 check unused`.
- The collapsed `npm.run` summary names the script (`run check, exit 0`), read from npm's banner: `> name@version script` on stdout (npm 10) or `npm notice run name@version script` on stderr (npm 11+). Falls back to `run, exit N` when there is no banner.
- Without `attempts`, `pr.waitForChecks` and `ci.waitForRun` now poll until `timeoutMs` is spent, instead of stopping after 12 polls. An explicit `attempts` still caps the wait (1-120).

Validation: `delivery.validate({ coverage: true, packageCheck: true })` passed.

Live Pi acceptance (reload, then check the collapsed pending and npm.run rows) is still to do, so this PR doesn't close the issue.
